content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for ICAR IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the ICAR-Indian Agricultural Research Institute (ICAR IARI), New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in ICAR IARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions are Project Associate I and Field Worker.

faq.question: Q3. What is the total number of vacancies announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for these positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for ICAR IARI Jobs?
faq.answer: The mode of application is Walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q5. When is the walk-in interview scheduled for?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 27 October 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the educational qualification required for Project Associate I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in Genetics/Plant Breeding/Biotechnology with 4/5 years' bachelor's degree or NET/GATE qualification, or a Master's degree in Natural/Agricultural Sciences/MVSC or a bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology, or Medicine.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification required for Field Worker?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Graduate degree in any discipline from a recognized university.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for the Project Associate I post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for Project Associate I is 35 years, with age relaxations applicable for reserved categories.

faq.question: Q9. What is the salary offered for Project Associate I?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 31,000 + HRA for candidates selected through NET/GATE, and Rs. 25,000 + HRA for others.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a duly filled and signed application form, original educational and relevant documents, and one set of self-attested photocopies for verification.
